svg.desc: Worlds and Thread atlas. Story order progresses downward. Connections use reserved routing space. Full relationship and citation ledgers follow the chart. The HTML companion contains the complete accessible model.
svg.text: Back to the Future Part II
P2 single mutable timeline - revisions supersede, not branch
2D · categorical world columns · Story-order ranks, not elapsed time. Equal ranks do not assert physical simultaneity.
Amber S± — Split outcomes. + and − are signs, not fates.
Blue T — Directed transfers. B body · M memory · C consciousness · S signal · ? literal/unspecified mechanism.
Emerald V / L — Numbered visits and explicit links only. Emerald centre on a cable means the route follows that connection.
Slate rail — World identity. Cutoff means chart boundary, not destruction. Crossings are bridges; only markers are joins.
Evidence / fate — [n] opens the evidence record. × dead · ● alive · ? unknown · ∅ nonexistent. Purple dotted connections are

{"id": "canon", "kind": "canon_statement", "text": "Marty, Doc and Jennifer travel 1985->2015. Old Biff steals the DeLorean,
gives his younger self the Gray's Sports Almanac, returns. The timeline changes around them: 1985 becomes alt-1985 (Biff's
wealth, George dead, Lorraine married to Biff). Marty/Doc return to this alt-1985, then go back to November 12 1955 to steal
the almanac back and burn it; timeline begins restoring.", "title": "BTTF Part II (1989), theatrical cut"}
alt-history), rC (almanac burned, restoring toward rA). Story order follows the film's view order. Costs of the P2 reading
(Marty's 1955 presence during rA and rB simultaneously, Old Biff's return leg) are logged in OPEN_ISSUES.md per the

svg.text: Alt-1985 is a revision of one Hill Valley, not a second world. Costs of this reading recorded in OPEN_ISSUES.md.
